summary: The following analysis is based on draft bill text that was made available by the House of Representatives and may differ from the bill text as introduced. Dismantle Foreign Scam Syndicates Act This bill establishes an interagency task force to shut down criminal syndicates perpetuating mass online scams. This bill also explicitly authorizes sanctions against foreign individuals or entities operating or providing support to scam compounds. (Scam compounds target individuals for financial fraud and are concentrated in Southeast Asia.)   The President must establish an interagency task force to shut down transnational criminal syndicates that use large scam centers and forced labor of trafficked persons to perpetuate mass online scams against Americans.
